 PNG Jewellers Brings Its 194-Year Legacy to Ayodhya
~Member of Parliament and actor Ms Kangana Ranaut inaugurates the brand's 81st store
and 5th in Uttar Pradesh~

Ayodhya, 11 October 2026: India’s leading national jewellery brand, PNG Jewellers, opened
its new store in Ayodhya, strengthening its presence in Uttar Pradesh. The store is PNG
Jewellers’ 81st overall and its fifth in the state, following Lucknow, Kanpur, Gorakhpur and
Varanasi. The opening follows the encouraging response the brand has received from
customers across Uttar Pradesh and brings its collections closer to customers in Ayodhya.
Member of Parliament and Indian film actor Ms Kangana Ranaut inaugurated the store.
Located next to Rikabganj Women Police Station, the new store gives Ayodhya customers
access to PNG Jewellers’ products, collections, and quality service closer to home.
The occasion also marks the debut of Ram Katha, an exclusive collection inspired by the
Ramayana and the historical, cultural and spiritual heritage of Ayodhya. Launched by Ms
Kangana Ranaut, the collection is being introduced in its initial phase across PNG stores in
North India, with availability set to expand nationally to all PNG Jewellers stores soon. The
store also showcases a range of gold, diamond, temple and bridal jewellery for weddings,
festive occasions and everyday wear. Customers can explore PNG Jewellers’ collections,
including Saptam, Katha, Pratha, Eiina and Polmi, with designs crafted for local tastes.
Ayodhya, revered as the birthplace of Lord Shree Ram, draws people from across the country
for its temples, festivals and deeply rooted traditions. Jewellery is closely tied to weddings,
festivals and family celebrations in the city. The new store allows PNG Jewellers to serve
local customers more conveniently while continuing its expansion in Uttar Pradesh. To
celebrate the opening, the brand introduced limited-period inaugural offers of up to 50% off
on gold jewellery making charges and up to 100% off on diamond jewellery making
charges*, valid till 15th November, 2026.
Adding to the excitement of the festive season, PNG Jewellers brings together its brand
ambassadors Madhuri Dixit-Nene and Ranbir Kapoor for the first time in a special festive
television commercial. The campaign marks a significant moment, bringing together two of
Bollywood’s most iconic stars in a celebration of tradition, elegance and contemporary
appeal. This much-awaited collaboration also reflects PNG Jewellers’ vision of connecting its
nearly two-century-old legacy with a new generation of consumers.
Dr. Saurabh Gadgil, Chairman and Managing Director of PNG Jewellers, said, “Opening a
store in Ayodhya is a special moment for us. We have received an encouraging response
from customers across Uttar Pradesh, and we are pleased to bring PNG Jewellers closer to

 people in and around Ayodhya. We look forward to being part of their weddings, festivals
and family celebrations, while offering the legacy, trust and craftsmanship that our brand
has stood for over generations.”
Ms Kangana Ranaut added, “Ayodhya holds a special place in the hearts of so many people,
and I am delighted to be here for the opening of PNG Jewellers’ new store. Jewellery is
closely woven into how we celebrate our traditions, weddings and important moments with
family. I wish the PNG team every success in Ayodhya.’’

About PNG Jewellers
PNG Jewellers is one of the most reputed jewellers in the country, with over 194 years of
excellence in creativity and trusted service for customers all over the world. Under the

evolve as a globally relevant brand while staying rooted in its heritage of purity, trust, and
craftsmanship.

 Krystal Integrated Services Ltd. to Generate 10,000+ Jobs Across 25+ Cities in
Next Six Months
The company marks 25 years of operations, building on 9,500 employment opportunities
generated in FY2026-27
Mumbai, 10th October 2026: Krystal Integrated Services Ltd (KISL), a leading provider of
Integrated facility management solutions, plans to generate more than 10,000 employment
opportunities across 25+ cities between October 2026 and March 2027. The planned hiring will
span skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled roles across facility management, sanitation, staffing and
other service operations.
The company has already generated more than 9,500 employment opportunities across 40+
cities so far in FY2026–27, according to company data. Building on this momentum, the additional
hiring is expected to support project requirements across the company’s service portfolio.
As Krystal marks 25 years of operations, the company has built a pan-India services business
spanning facility management, staffing and payroll, security, catering and waste management.
Its operating footprint includes 4,068 locations across 20 states and four Union Territories,
supported by 41,676 on-site employees, according to its FY2025–26 annual report. The company
serves clients across sectors including healthcare, education, manufacturing, transport
infrastructure, logistics, retail and government institutions.
In FY2025–26, the company added more than 177 corporate customers across over 250 locations,
with the combined multi-year business value of these additions exceeding ₹300 crore.
Krystal’s business expansion has included large-scale facility management and sanitation
mandates, alongside its entry into city lighting and urban infrastructure through the acquisition
of Citelum India.
Mr. Sanjay Dighe, CEO and Whole-Time Director of Krystal Integrated Services Limited, said:
“As we mark 25 years, our focus is on building a services organisation equipped to meet the
evolving requirements of workplaces, public institutions and urban infrastructure. Our operating
experience has helped us develop the ability to mobilise teams and manage services across
diverse locations. As we expand our capabilities, creating employment opportunities while
strengthening workforce skills and service delivery will remain important to our growth.”

 Krystal reported consolidated revenue from operations of ₹1,277.3 crore in FY2025–26, an
increase of 5.32% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA rose 7.49% to ₹83.53 crore during the year.
The upcoming hiring programme is expected to support the company’s operational requirements
across its service locations. Krystal is also focusing on technically trained personnel and greater
mechanisation as it expands into specialised and engineering-led services.
About Krystal Integrated Services Limited:
KISL is a well-diversified service provider in integrated facility management services, staffing
solutions, security services, catering and waste management across India. The Company
specializes in sectors such as healthcare, education, City infrastructure, Waste Management
and Manufacturing segment—including state government entities, Corporate clients, municipal
bodies and other government offices—airports, railways, metro infrastructure and retail. The
company offers a comprehensive range of integrated facility management services across these
varied sectors. Additionally, KISL provides staffing solutions and payroll management, private
security and manned guarding services and catering services. Over the fiscal years 2021 to 2026,
KISL’s customer base has grown to over 570, with operations spanning more than 4,000
locations across India.
The Company is also providing services in solid waste management as well as water waste
management. The team’s expertise covers bio-mining of legacy waste, Common Effluent
Treatment Plants (CETP) and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) technologies.
